release_scope: Aggregate metadata only; no original posts, annotations, evidence spans, or individual-level model outputs are distributed.

development.curation: Retrospective balanced subset of 177 development posts; 27 classification-only posts removed. Current ordered classifier selections and all 60 RAG examples preserved.

data_access: The underlying dataset is not publicly released. Researchers may request access by emailing Kun Wang (2511110190@pku.edu.cn) or Beibei Xu (xubeibei@bjmu.edu.cn). Requests are considered individually; access is not guaranteed.
